A''' [[Clone gunner/Legends|Clone tank gunner''']] served under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone trooper commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]].<ref name="Padawan Lost" />

==Biography==
He served in the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]] and manned an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]]. He fired on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] outpost on the planet with the [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|Mass-driver cannon]] located on the top of the AT-TE on the order of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].<ref name="Padawan Lost" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
He was voiced, like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. He only appeared in one episode of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]. The helmet's markings was designed by [[Dave Filoni|David Filoni]] for a production asset called "Clone Pilot 104th", a Clone Pilot of the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Legion]].<ref name="Art of TCW">{{StoryCite|story=The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars (booklet)|book=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|bformatted=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|sformatted=''The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars''|smanual=1}}</ref> This asset was never used and the helmet design ended up on this unidentified Clone Tank Gunner.
